title: My Dad Said My Games Were Wrecking Our New Floor #shorts

cast.dad: a stick-figure father with a round white head, dot eyes, thin black limbs, short brown hair and a blue flannel shirt
cast.girl: a stick-figure girl with a round white head, dot eyes, thin black limbs, two black pigtails and a purple hoodie

lines.text: Dad said my gaming was wrecking our brand new floor, so who really scratched it?
lines.label: hook
lines.headline: who scratched the floor
lines.image: {girl} is the only person in the picture, standing in a living room on a shiny new light wood floor, pointing down at a few clear straight white scratch lines on the wood floor, worried face, evening

lines.text: Dad put in shiny new wood floors, then scratches showed up by my gaming desk.
lines.label: new floor
lines.headline: scratches by the desk
lines.image: {girl} is the only person in the picture, sitting at exactly one small gaming desk on exactly one rolling desk chair, looking down at clear straight white scratch lines on the shiny light wood floor beside the desk, puzzled face, afternoon

lines.text: Dad said, "My floor was perfect before your gaming started, so your chair did it."
lines.label: the charge
lines.headline: dad blames the chair
lines.image: {dad} is the only person in the picture, standing on shiny new wood floor with arms crossed, pointing at exactly one rolling desk chair, stern face, mouth open talking, a bright living room

lines.text: He locked my console and my rolling chair in the garage for a whole month.
lines.label: stakes
lines.headline: console locked away
lines.image: {dad} is the only person in the picture, carrying exactly one game console and pushing exactly one rolling desk chair into a dim garage, stern face

lines.text: Three mornings later, there were fresh scratches in the hallway, where my chair never goes.
lines.label: worse
lines.headline: hallway scratches
lines.image: {girl} is the only person in the picture, kneeling in an empty hallway with a shiny light wood floor, staring wide-eyed at clear straight white scratch lines on the floor, no chair anywhere, morning light

lines.text: Dad said I must be sneaking around at night, so he took my phone too.
lines.label: more blame
lines.headline: phone gone too
lines.image: {dad} is the only person in the picture, standing in a hallway holding exactly one phone up high out of reach, frowning, evening light

lines.text: I sat alone on my bed and cried, grounded for scratches I never even made.
lines.label: alone
lines.headline: blamed for nothing
lines.image: close-up of {girl} sitting alone on her bed hugging her knees, a single tear running down her cheek, sad eyes looking down, dim bedroom

lines.text: Then I noticed the scratches ran in straight rows that turned sharp at every wall.
lines.label: the rows
lines.headline: straight rows
lines.image: {girl} is the only person in the picture, standing in a doorway looking down at a light wood floor covered in long straight parallel white scratch lines that turn at a sharp right angle at the wall, eyes wide, realizing, morning

lines.text: In every game I play, only computer guards patrol like that, never a real person.
lines.label: gamer clue
lines.headline: guards patrol like that
lines.image: {girl} is the only person in the picture, sitting cross-legged on her bedroom floor, thinking hard with one finger on her chin, a simple drawing of a guard walking a square path in a thought bubble above her head

lines.text: So at two AM, I watched Dad's robot vacuum roll out from under my desk.
lines.label: the twist
lines.headline: the 2 AM robot
lines.image: {girl} is the only person in the picture, peeking from behind a doorframe in a dark room at two in the morning, watching exactly one small round robot vacuum roll out from under exactly one small desk, moonlight, tense

lines.text: A tiny pebble stuck in its wheel was carving lines all over Dad's new floor.
lines.label: the proof
lines.headline: pebble in the wheel
lines.image: {girl} is the only person in the picture, kneeling on a light wood floor in a dark hallway, holding exactly one small round robot vacuum upside down, pointing at one small gray pebble stuck in its wheel, a straight white scratch line on the floor behind her, shocked face, moonlight

lines.text: Console's back, Dad blames my muddy sneakers for the pebble, and I blame his robot.
lines.label: payoff
lines.headline: team dad or team me
lines.image: {girl} is the only person in the picture, sitting happily on exactly one rolling desk chair at her gaming desk holding exactly one game controller, grinning, exactly one small round robot vacuum parked in a corner, cozy evening
